column3: Manami Route ・ Hasty Girlfriend
Kyou-chan...
D-Do you really not understand...?
What's up with this girl... What is she expecting from me?
It looks like she's really bothered by this... I don't understand girls at all.
Say... Manami. Is there something you want from me?
T-There's no- !
There is. Your eyes say it. Your attitude says it.
Ugh, nghh....
Kyou-chan, you're so dumb...
What?! Now you've done it!
No～! Don't mess up my hair～!
So... In the end, what exactly do you want?  Just say it honestly.
No, wait... This scene, hasn't it already happened before?
Like, something would seem really serious and important, but in the end, truly and utterly pointless...
Like the time her bangs got shorter...
Say... Manami... You're pulling the same pattern on me again, aren't you...?
Well... Umm...
Gaaaaaaah! The awkward silence is hereee!!
Ky-Kyou-chan...
At this point, even I can understand...
The mood is already set... I guess we have to kiss...!
*Gulp*
This kind of development has never happened before.
Choices written in huge letters are floating in my head.
Calm down, Kyousuke. This isn't an Adventure Game!
There's no skip or reset!
Kyou-chan...
Y-Yeah...
G-Go ahead...
Don't just say "go ahead" like you're giving me a second helping of dinner...
Even for me... I have to be mentally prepared and all...
Is this even okay...? Kissing Manami... right here, right now...
No, wait! Waiiit a minute-!!
Manami, your glasses are all fogged up!
Ah! Hauu...
A-Alright! The mood changed!
W-Was I making a weird face?
Just a little...
S-Stupid Kyou-chan!
Ahaha! Sorry, I said just a little!
Even if it's only a little, I still don't like it.
I don't mind.
Well, I do! Geez!
Seeing her make that cute angry face, it almost felt like the usual Manami.
Yeah, this is much better. No matter how much she pouts and whines about it, I like it this way.
After resting for a moment, I see something in the corner of my vision. Between the park's groves of trees, something briefly moved. Something black,
with a familiar shadow.
Huh? Don't tell me that's...
Ohhh...
K-K-Ku-Ku-Kur?!
W-Why is Kuroneko here!?
W-What's wrong, Kyou-chan?
No, nothing, it's... nothing!
No, calm down! Calm down Kyousuke! I'm still on edge from earlier.
That unnerving feeling is making me see things! Yeah, that's it! No matter which way you look at it, the possibility is undeniable...! Right...?
This is nothing more than an illusion! That's right! No question! I'll just take one last glance...
This is definitely not an illusion～! She's even watching us now! In fact she's glaring?!
Kyou-chan... Is something wrong? What are you looking at?
Ah! It's nothing! But hey, Manami!
Hu-Huh? W-What's exactly is the matter, Kyou-chan?
Wait here just a moment! I'll be right back! I just need to psych myself up in that restroom over there!
O-Okay! Understood, gotta psych yourself up, right! D-Do you have that doll?
No, I'm fine without it. Okay, I'm off!
Yes! Understood! Good luck!
Right!
But why am I getting so nervous about this?! It's not like I did anything, and there's nothing to be nervous about anyway... but...
..."This is bad".
That single phrase was continually tumbling around inside.
